title.en: Daxing: building a new Sui capital

summary.en: In 582, Emperor Wen ordered officials led by Gao Jiong to construct a new capital near Longshou Mountain. The city received the name Daxing that December. In spring 583, the emperor entered the new capital. Construction and the court’s move were successive steps, rather than one founding event in 584.
summary.zh: 582年，隋文帝命高熲等官员在龙首山一带营建新都，同年十二月定名大兴城。583年春，皇帝迁入新都。营建与迁都先后发生，并非同在584年完成的一次建都。

dateNote.en: 582–583: construction order and naming, followed by the court’s move. This corrects the inherited 584 anchor.
dateNote.zh: 582—583年：下令营建、命名，再迁入新都；据本纪校正原条目的584年。

labelI18n.zh: 大兴城／西安：都城参考点

note.en: Separated capital construction from unsupported bundled legal and administrative reform claims; preserved the original record and geographic reference.
note.zh: 将营建新都与未获此段支持的法制、官制改革分开，保留原始记录及地理参考点。

title.en: Luoyang and the Tongji Canal: imperial construction in 605

summary.en: Emperor Yang commissioned Yang Su, Yang Da and Yuwen Kai to build the eastern capital at Luoyang. The same year, conscripted workers opened the Tongji Canal, connecting the Gu and Luo waters with the Yellow River and a further route from Banzhu to the Huai. The Suishu records completion of the eastern capital in 606.
summary.zh: 隋炀帝命杨素、杨达、宇文恺营建洛阳东京。同年征发民众开通济渠，由谷、洛水连接黄河，再由板渚引黄河水通向淮河。《隋书》把东京建成记在606年。

dateNote.en: 605 marks the construction orders and canal works; the eastern capital’s completion is recorded in 606.
dateNote.zh: 605年为营建命令及开河之年；东京建成另记在606年。

title.en: Emperor Yang orders the Jiangnan Canal works

summary.en: In 610, Emperor Yang ordered a navigable route from Jingkou to Yuhang, wide enough for imperial dragon boats. Relay palaces and supply stations were also ordered for a projected journey toward Kuaiji. This account concerns the court’s instructions and travel infrastructure; the related Yuhang entry follows the southern endpoint of the same project.
summary.zh: 610年，隋炀帝下令开通京口至余杭的江南河，使之能够通行龙舟，并设置驿宫、草顿，为计划中的会稽巡行准备设施。本条关注朝廷命令与巡行设施；关联的余杭条目介绍同一工程的南端。

dateNote.en: Twelfth lunar month of Daye 6 (610). The passage records an order, not a completion date for the whole Grand Canal.
dateNote.zh: 大业六年（610）农历十二月。原文记开河命令，并非整个大运河的完工日期。

summary.en: The 610 canal order named Jingkou and Yuhang as its endpoints. The Zizhi Tongjian describes a route of more than eight hundred li and specifies a channel capable of carrying dragon boats. Yuhang marks the southern end of this recorded project. The paired imperial-order entry describes the same works from the perspective of court travel and provisioning.
summary.zh: 610年的开河命令以京口、余杭为两端。《资治通鉴》记其长八百余里，并规定河道须能通行龙舟。余杭是这项有明确记载的工程南端。关联的朝廷命令条目从巡行与供给角度介绍同一工程。

dateNote.en: 610 anchors the order for this corridor; it does not date the beginning of all Hangzhou water transport. The historical li are not converted into precise modern kilometres.
dateNote.zh: 610年标示此区段的开河命令，并非杭州水运的起点；原文里数不换算为精确现代公里数。

title.en: Yehuling: Mongol forces break Jin defenses
title.zh: 野狐岭：蒙古军突破金军防线

summary.en: The Yuanshi annals place Genghis Khan’s victory at Yehuling in 1211 and record a further victory at Huihechuan later that year. Muqali’s biography gives him a leading role in the assault. It calls the Jin force an army reportedly numbering 400,000; that is a claimed strength, not a count of soldiers killed. The biography also arranges these fighting episodes differently from the annals.
summary.zh: 《元史》本纪将成吉思汗在野狐岭获胜记于1211年，并记当年稍后在会河川再次击败金军。木华黎传突出其突阵作用，称金军“号四十万”；这是号称兵力，并非阵亡人数。列传与本纪对这些战事的编排亦有差别。

dateNote.en: 1211 follows the Taizu annals. Muqali’s biography groups the episode under a different yearly sequence; the reported army size is not a casualty total.
dateNote.zh: 1211年据太祖本纪；木华黎传的年度编排不同，号称兵力不作死亡总数。

note.en: Removed a claim that 400,000 soldiers were annihilated; attributed the reported number and separated two primary-text chronologies.
note.zh: 删去歼灭四十万人的断言，明确数字出处，并区分两处史文的纪年编排。

title.en: Heishui in the 1226 Western Xia campaign

summary.en: Genghis Khan began another campaign against Western Xia in 1226. The Yuanshi records the capture of Heishui and other towns in the second lunar month, followed by fighting at Gan, Su and Lingzhou. The campaign continued into 1227, the year of his death. A separate geographical entry dates the Yijina administration to 1286: conquest and later provincial organization were different stages.
summary.zh: 1226年，成吉思汗再次亲征西夏。《元史》记二月取黑水等城，其后进取甘、肃并攻灵州；战役延续至1227年，成吉思汗亦在该年去世。地理志另将亦集乃总管府的设立记于1286年，征服与后续行政建置属于不同阶段。

dateNote.en: 1226 marks the campaign and the annals’ Heishui entry. The Yijina administration is dated separately to 1286.
dateNote.zh: 1226年为战役及本纪黑水城记录之年；亦集乃总管府另记于1286年。

note.en: Separated the conquest from a later administrative institution and replaced compressed heroic wording with the annals’ sequence.
note.zh: 区分征服与后续建置，以本纪次序替换压缩的英雄化措辞。

title.en: The Luntai decree: rejecting a new frontier-farming proposal
title.zh: 轮台诏令：拒绝新的边地屯田提议

summary.en: Sang Hongyang and other ministers proposed agricultural garrisons east of Luntai, supported by irrigation, supplies and fortified posts. Emperor Wu rejected the proposal. The decree preserved in the Hanshu recounts deaths during supply journeys, Li Guangli’s defeat and the failure of favorable divinations. It calls for curbing unauthorized levies and supporting agriculture, while also maintaining horses and military readiness. Its specific limits on expansion sit alongside continued concern for frontier defense.
summary.zh: 桑弘羊等大臣建议在轮台以东设屯田，由灌溉、粮运与亭障支持。汉武帝拒绝这一提议。《汉书》保存的诏书追述粮运途中的死亡、李广利战败，以及占卜吉兆的失验；要求禁止擅赋、力本农，同时养马补缺、保持武备。对扩张的具体限制，与继续维持边防并存。

dateNote.en: 89 BCE follows the Zizhi Tongjian’s Zhenghe 4 sequence. The court reference point does not establish the decree’s exact place of issue.
dateNote.zh: 前89年据《资治通鉴》征和四年的编排；朝廷参考点不表示已核实诏令发布地点。
